answer: A practical defence is Proof of unique yoga studio class passes. It rests on classes booked at one studio for eighteen months, which gives every honest agent a zenith that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. What the farm fears is not one hard check but a check that cannot be shared: classes booked at one studio for eighteen months is per-account by construction, and the nadir is that the tenth clone costs as much as the first. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the ember is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
